title: Neutralisation and pH
goal: Add sodium hydroxide to hydrochloric acid and predict whether the result is acidic, neutral or basic.
intro: This beaker holds 25 mL of dilute hydrochloric acid with a few drops of universal indicator. Choose how much sodium hydroxide to add, then make your call.

safety: Wear goggles: even dilute hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide can harm your eyes, so rinse any splash with plenty of water.
